results.title: Ebola cases in DR Congo pass 11,000, with 5,387 deaths
results.content: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 11,042, according to government data, with at least 5,387 deaths.

results.title: Dr Nyaho-Tamakloe: Celebrating Hearts of Oak’s 115 years of history, excellence and institutional development
results.content: Today, as Accra Hearts of Oak Sporting Club celebrates its 115th anniversary, I consider it a great honour to join the entire Phobian fraternity, both in Ghana and across the world, in commemorating the remarkable journey of one of Africa's most distinguished football institutions. This anniversary provides an important opportunity to reflect upon our history, celebrate our achievements, appreciate the sacrifices of those who have contributed to our development and renew our collective commitment to building a stronger institution for future generations.

results.title: Gbentri-Nakpanduri Road: Agbodza vows to address abandoned 40km stretch
results.content: The government is seeking a lasting solution to a 40-kilometre section of the Gbentri-Nakpanduri Road in the North East Region that was left out of the existing construction contract, creating a major break in the road project.

results.title: Nkokonkitinkiti poultry policy has not failed — Otokunor
results.content: Dr Peter Boamah Otokunor, Director of Presidential Initiatives in Agriculture and Agribusiness, has rejected claims that the government’s Nkokonkitinkiti poultry policy has failed, describing such assertions as defective.

results.title: African parties must prepare to govern, not just win elections — Asiedu Nketiah
results.content: Political parties across Africa must move beyond the pursuit of electoral victories and build the institutional strength and expertise needed to govern effectively, the new Chairman of the African Political Parties Initiative (APPI), Johnson Asiedu Nketiah, has said.

results.title: 2027 Budget: How Mahama plans to turn Ghana’s fortunes with $10bn ‘New Economy’ plan
results.content: Ghana’s next phase of economic management is expected to place greater emphasis on what the economy produces, how much it processes locally and the jobs its industries can create, as the government prepares to roll out a US$10 billion investment programme over four years.

results.title: ‘New economy is repackaged 24-hour economy’ – Manso Nkwanta MP
